headline: Lokesh Machines director resigns from the board
summary: Lokesh Machines Limited has officially notified the NSE regarding the resignation of a Director, Key Managerial Personnel (KMP), or Senior Management Personnel (SMP). The company did not specify the name of the individual or the reason for the departure in the initial filing. This change in leadership structure is a routine corporate disclosure.
why_it_matters: Leadership exits can signal internal shifts or strategic changes.

headline: P.Kodanda Rami Reddy resigns as Lokesh Machines Company Secretary
summary: Lokesh Machines Limited has announced the resignation of Mr P.Kodanda Rami Reddy from his role as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective October 10, 2026. The exchange filing details the departure of this key managerial personnel without citing a specific reason. Such exits in smaller-cap firms can occasionally cause procedural adjustments in regulatory filings. Indian retail shareholders of the company should note this routine corporate governance change.
whats_next: Appointment of a new compliance officer
why_it_matters: Routine management change with no immediate financial impact
